text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging @oncall-ryan - alert: runtime-group-03 elevated 5xxs (503/504) for model 'redwood-gpt-q8' across multiple hosts. Error rate >6% over 5m. link: https://ops.redwood/alerts/INC-1805126789 :rotating_light:

oncall-ryan: oncall here, joining call. starting quick triage.

sre-ana: saw spikes from 03-10, 03-11. logs show repeated 'segfault' and 'cuda out of memory' on inference worker.

eng-runtime-mike: joining - pulling logs now, could be quantized kernel path. quick grep:

```
# tail -n 200 /var/log/runner/host-03-10.log
[2026-03-14T10:02:12Z] ERROR inference: runtime panic: sigsegv at kernel run
[2026-03-14T10:02:12Z] ERROR model-runner: failed batch: OOM allocating 2048MB
[2026-03-14T10:02:13Z] WARN kvcache: evicting prefix
```

paul-ml: customers on Dedicated might see retries -> 503s. Julia-CS, do we have incoming customer tickets?

julia-cs: yes, CX reported 503s for AlphaCorp production routes starting ~10:01UTC. They're seeing timeouts on streaming responses. Raising priority.

oncall-ryan: immediate mitigations: 1) remove model variant 'redwood-gpt-q8' from routing, 2) route to fallback fp16 variant, 3) cordon affected hosts, 4) scale up small pool to absorb traffic. I'll start 1 and 2 now.

sre-ana: cordon commands:

```
# mark hosts unschedulable
infractl node cordon host-03-10 host-03-11
# drain after in-flight finishes
infractl node drain host-03-10 host-03-11 --grace-period 30s
```

eng-runtime-mike: disabling q8 variant via routing policy: `redwoodctl routes disable-variant redwood-gpt-q8 --group runtime-group-03`

deploy-bot: rollback triggered: routing-rule redwood-gpt -> fallback/redwood-gpt-fp16 (user-visible change id r-20260314-01)

incident-bot: Note: routing change r-20260314-01 will take ~15s to propagate to edge routers.

paul-ml: rolling redirects now, monitoring 5xx. Julia, please tell AlphaCorp we're mitigating and will follow up.

julia-cs: pinged AlphaCorp with brief: "we're routing to a safe variant and investigating root cause; temporary degradation may continue for 10-20m".

oncall-ryan: after removing variant, 5xx rate dropped to ~1.2% within 3m. Good signal. We're still seeing occasional OOMs from host-03-12.

eng-runtime-mike: hypothesis: a recent kernel optimization for q8 path introduced memory corruption under specific sequence lengths. Reproduced locally on host-03-12 with long context >8k tokens. Reproduction snippet:

```
python reproduce.py --model redwood-gpt-q8 --seq-len 9000 --batch 4
# triggers SIGSEGV after ~1200 tokens
```

oncall-ryan: next steps: 1) keep q8 variant disabled; 2) schedule emergency rollback of q8 runtime commit (sha abc123) from yesterday; 3) repro bug ticket and attach logs; 4) notify customers and update incident status. Who owns runtime commit rollback?

eng-runtime-mike: I can revert the kernel change. Will open PR to revert and push hotfix. ETA 25m for build + test.

sre-ana: meanwhile, cordoned hosts are being drained. If host count becomes low, autoscaling triggered new healthy nodes.

deploy-bot: hotfix pipeline queued (job id ci-8245). Build started.

paul-ml: any data loss / customer data exposure? Looks like only inference panics, no persisted data affected. Confirmed: no logs contain customer payloads.

julia-cs: AlphaCorp acknowledged, wants ETA and if SLA credit applies. I've escalated to AE.

oncall-ryan: handoff: I'm going offline for a short break but will remain reachable. Handoff to @sre-ana to watch post-mitigation.

sre-ana: taking over monitoring. If error_rate >2% again, rollback complete, we will re-open paging.

eng-runtime-mike: hotfix built and deployed to staging. Running smoke:

```
# smoke run
smoketest --model redwood-gpt-q8 --seq 2048 --batch 8
RESULT: PASS
```

eng-runtime-mike: rolling hotfix to runtime-group-03 canary on 3 hosts then full. Will monitor for segfaults.

incident-bot: canary deployment initiated (canary id can-20260314-01).

oncall-ryan: back online - saw canary metrics, no segfaults so far, latency stable. If green for 15m, we can re-enable q8 variant. But prefer to keep q8 disabled until we validate with long-context load tests.

julia-cs: AlphaCorp asked for timeline. Recommend telling them: "mitigation applied, full validation ongoing, ETA 3-4 hours for full re-enable or permanent fix".

paul-ml: creating incident ticket INC-20260314-1805126789 and assigning eng-runtime for postmortem.

eng-runtime-mike: root cause preliminary: unsafe memory access in q8 attention kernel under long sequences causing GPU memory corruption -> OOM/SIGSEGV. Fix reverted in hotfix and will add fuzz tests + long-seq CI.

oncall-ryan: good work team. Follow-up actions: 1) postmortem with timeline and customer impact, 2) add long-context regression tests to PR template, 3) alert tuning to reduce noisy pages for known degradation modes.

incident-bot: incident status -> mitigated. Next update scheduled in 1h for postmortem start. :heavy_check_mark:
